_README: Amendment A32. Human market scale per mechanism class, hand-curated with a source for each.
WHY A CLASS AND NOT A PRODUCT. A per-molecule pass was attempted and abandoned: 9 searches
yielded ~4 citable company-reported figures, the rest returning market-research projections,
CAGR forecasts or prior-year numbers, none of which meet this site's sourcing standard.
Classes are tiered instead, and a molecule inherits its class.
WHY A PROXY AND NOT A MEASURE. Two earlier attempts failed and are recorded so they are not
retried. Counting human programs per target measured how GENERIC the target string is, not market
value: Dupixent scored 1 (the floor) and inhaled treprostinil topped the list at 14. Approval age
as a generic proxy was equally wrong: only 5 of the 24 dropped route-2 molecules predate 2000.
WHAT A TIER IS A CLAIM ABOUT. The HUMAN franchise for that mechanism. It is NOT a claim about the
companion-animal opportunity, which this repository holds no data on at all. Dupixent's $14.15B is
human atopic dermatitis; that canine atopic dermatitis is also commercially large is a separate
fact this review has not established. Opsumit's PAH revenue says nothing about dog PAH, which is
rare. Read the tier as 'how big is this mechanism in people', nothing more.
INHERITANCE HAS A KNOWN FAILURE. Under the franchise rule a small product inside a large franchise
inherits the large tier. Cometriq is the clearest case: Exelixis reports $1,809.4M for Cabometyx
plus Cometriq combined, but Cometriq alone is $2.4M. Where a product-level figure was found and it
contradicts its class, the molecule carries an override below rather than the class tier.

tiers.not established: no company-reported product figure found; never guessed

HER2-targeted.basis: Perjeta $1.9B FY2024; trastuzumab franchise large but biosimilar-eroded

Factor Xa anticoagulant.basis: Eliquis is among the largest cardiovascular franchises worldwide

cytotoxic chemotherapy.basis: paclitaxel, cytarabine and gemcitabine are long-established multi-source generics; no branded franchise remains

cardiovascular generic.basis: losartan, furosemide, ivabradine, vasopressin and esaxerenone are off-patent or regionally-marketed commodities

corticosteroid.basis: betamethasone and triamcinolone are long-established generics; Zilretta is a formulation play

IL-6R.basis: Kevzara $94.1M in Q1 2024 only; Sanofi books global sales and Regeneron books profit share, so no clean product-level annual figure

FGFR inhibitor.basis: J&J does not break out Balversa revenue

SERD / ER-targeted.basis: Inluriyo and vepdegestrant are not yet commercially established; any figure would be a forecast

oncolytic virus.basis: Amgen does not break out Imlygic revenue

Cometriq (cabozantinib).basis: Cometriq alone is $2.4M FY2024; the $1,809.4M Exelixis reports is Cabometyx plus Cometriq combined, and Cabometyx is not this candidate

Attruby (acoramidis).basis: approved 22 Nov 2024; $2.9M FY2024 is a launch stub, not a market scale

MYQORZO (aficamten).basis: not yet commercially established; Camzyos anchors the class but this asset has no sales history
